definitions.explanation: A delivery option where packages are left at the door, in a designated spot, or in a delivery box without requiring a signature or direct handoff.

examples.japanese: {置|お}き{配|はい}でお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please leave it at the door.

examples.japanese: {置|お}き{配|はい}を{指定|してい}したら{玄関前|げんかんまえ}に{届|とど}いていた。
examples.english: When I selected leave-at-door delivery, it was left at the front entrance.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{置|お}き{配|はい}だと{濡|ぬ}れてしまうことがある。
examples.english: On rainy days, packages left at the door can get wet.

notes:
{置|お}き{配|はい} became popular during the COVID-19 pandemic as a contactless delivery option.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {置|お}き{配|はい}を{指定|してい}する (to select leave-at-door delivery)
- {置|お}き{配|はい}で{届|とど}く (to be delivered via leave-at-door)
- {置|お}き{配|はい}{場所|ばしょ} (leave-at-door delivery location)

RELATED WORDS:
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックス: delivery locker
- {再配達|さいはいたつ}: redelivery
- {対面|たいめん}{受|う}け{取|と}り: in-person receipt
